codeReview.summary: The original harness commit `cd6b62e` left `testBatchRenderFailureDowngradesToFrameSameSession` proving only that the frame backend attached after a batch render error. The fix commit `ba342765d44073fa6aef80f0594c4e38708283ef` closes that gap by asserting the fallback frame backend actually renders once after the induced batch-render failure and that the rendered frame carries the expected clear color. Given `WinSwiftUIWindowHost.renderCurrentFrame` falls back and immediately retries `renderer.render(frame:)` in the same `windowNeedsDisplay` call (`Sources/WinSwiftUI/App.swift:452-461`), the updated assertions now provide validator-visible proof that the triggering frame is presented through the frame path in the same session.
